---
title: "Lecture 32 — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. Overfit = low bias / high variance; underfit = high bias / low variance.
2. It can mean memorization: tiny train bias with huge sensitivity to the particular sample.
3. Polynomial degree (or number of basis features).
4. Overparameterize / reach a low-bias regime (even overfit train), then push back.
5. A technique that **increases bias** (deliberately) to reduce variance / improve test risk.
